# Shared Silmarillion design route

When planning, creating, implementing, reviewing or verifying art, narrative,
maps, assets or UI/UX, load
[silmarillion-art-direction](../../.agents/skills/silmarillion-art-direction/SKILL.md)
and its task-specific resources before work. Unrelated ops tasks do not need
the design package. Requirements live in that package, not in this adapter.

Planner: identify applicable rules and acceptance criteria. Implementer: use
the approved tokens, asset contracts and state patterns. Reviewer: check
source fidelity, visual consistency and usability. Verifier: check manifests,
configuration, rendered evidence and limitations.

Copilot may apply this file through its scoped-instruction loader. Codex must
read it through the explicit references in `AGENTS.md`, project configuration
and native role instructions; the `applyTo` field alone does not load it there.
